note: Accepted pre-registration exemptions for the queue_row gate. Law: src/os/queue_row_exempt.py. An identity is the first backticked token of the row when it has one, otherwise the row leading ASCII token plus # and a sha8 of the row text - never a line number, so inserting rows above changes nothing. Each entry carries the round that accepted it and why. An entry whose row later declares its criteria prefix simply stops matching and is reported as unmatched, so an exemption can never outlive the condition that justified it.
